name: Sunny Lagoon
desc: bright turquoise shallow water, soft sparkling bubbles and glints, soft white sand slopes and swaying seagrass and little pastel corals at the edges.

name: Coral Cove
desc: warm rose-pink water, towering coral reef walls in coral, orange, pink and purple on both sides, tiny glowing fish schools in the distance.

name: Kelp Forest
desc: emerald and teal water, tall swaying golden-green kelp ribbons framing both edges, mossy rocks, firefly-like green glowing specks.

name: Shipwreck Bay
desc: murky teal water, a weathered old wooden pirate shipwreck with masts leaning on one side, a glowing treasure chest and gold coins on the seabed rocks, schools of tiny fish.

name: Pearl Palace
desc: pearly iridescent pastel water in pink, lavender and mint, a dreamy mermaid palace with onion domes and spires made of shimmering pearl and shell rising at the edges, floating pearl bubbles.

name: Jellyfish Grove
desc: deep violet and indigo water filled with softly glowing lavender jellyfish drifting at the edges, trailing tentacles, floating sparkles, dreamy purple glow.

name: Twilight Deep
desc: deep midnight-blue water, faint moon-like light from far above, huge friendly manta ray and whale silhouettes in the haze, drifting glowing plankton, calm and hushed.

name: Starlight Trench
desc: near-black navy water inside a deep glittering trench, walls covered in bioluminescent anemones and starry glowing coral in cyan, pink and violet, constellations of sparkles; at the very end a grand, glowing royal throne alcove and a swirling luminous whirlpool portal.
